evidence_source: Successful exec_command/write_stdin tool outputs from the lean_runtime agent's earlier focused backend runs in this conversation. No standalone raw test log file was found; this receipt reconstructs the commands and reported results, not a new run.
source_hash_note: No per-source hash was recorded by these test commands. Later distribution and benchmark receipts separately pin the built compiler and emitted artifacts.

tests.scope: Compiles and executes generated C using cc with C11/O2/fno-fast-math. Covers U32/U64/I32/F32/Bool/vector/record layouts, exact F32 bits, unchanged inputs, empty/self concat, one fresh concat allocation, helper evaluation once, contextual map literals, packed U32 borrowed ingress, output consumption before reset, and unsupported nested-layout rejection. This standalone run is native C, not a Wasm device execution.

Compiles and executes standalone generated Rust with rustc --edition=2021 -O. Covers U32/U64/Bool/String/nested lists/records, fresh result and unchanged operands, same-input/empty cases, exactly one clone per result record element, computed receivers and contextual literals; uses no unsafe aliasing.
Checks U32 and U64 direct concat manifests have no shader and explicitly report compiled CPU fallback. No GPU device execution or performance measurement is claimed.
